summary: No source found describes a fire lookout at Orton, Brunswick County; the only listing is the tnlandforms NC tower list. No story written.

evidence.supports: Orton is listed in Brunswick County with no NGS station (0 bm)

notes_for_editor: No story written: no source I could reach describes a lookout at Orton. Checked: the tnlandforms NC list (NCT123, no NGS station); the cached eastern-lookouts NC list, which has Brunswick County towers at Bolivia, Riegel and Shallotte but no Orton; the Wikipedia page for Orton Plantation, the house (NRHP 1973), which mentions no tower; two web searches. Not proposed as hidden, because the tnlandforms list is itself a tower source and absence from one list is weak evidence. Suggest a human check against the NC Forest Service or FFLA records before the record is kept or hidden. Brief status and access unknown; no change made.
